## Overview

This 2026-09-15 Adyen page is an Android integration chooser for Online Banking Thailand. It routes to method-specific Android Drop-in and Components guides and to the main Android Sessions and Advanced flow guides. It does not itself specify prerequisites, version minima, request fields, test/live eligibility, or payment outcomes. See [[adyen]], [[adyen-online-payments]], and [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-online-banking-thailand]] for the method overview.

## Key takeaways

- Drop-in is described here as Adyen's all-in-one UI option; Components points to a `MolpayComponent` redirect route. These are links and brief labels, not a complete implementation procedure.
- The page says to create the main integration before adding Online Banking Thailand and links four base guides: Android Drop-in and Android Components, each with Sessions and Advanced flows. The child guides carry their own flow-specific conditions.
